response.sql: SELECT AVG(mean_product_price) AS average_invoice_mean_product_price, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice FROM (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.product_price) AS mean_product_price, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) AS invoice_summary;
